title: Choose data and project removal separately
need: Local universe or self-hosted server data may be the only copy; the warning names which. Backup choice and which project layers to remove are distinct; there is no automatic backup; each backup archive is named for the universe it holds and printed once by its final full path, never by the staged export name; and any answer other than backup/no-backup cancels with exit 0 and no changes. Explicit unattended choices are required.
surface: Install -> Uninstall -> command help and first prompts.
